versions.changelog: v1.3.3: README rewrite (plain English, no AI-template phrasing) + new Chinese README_zh.md + annotate rank_genes_groups gets the same 500-gene cap that markers got in v1.3.1 (closes the v1.3.1 TODO). No CLI surface change. 203 tests pass.

v1.3.2 hardening: surface decision rationales in HTML report (chosen resolution + panel auto-pick + self-check triggers all render their rationale instead of bare codes); 17 new regression tests for _pick_best_resolution and _autopick_panel_for_data (previously 0 coverage); CLAUDE.md updated to reflect v1.3 frozen scRNA surface (multi-omics deferred to v2.0). 203 tests pass on hospital. No CLI surface change.

v1.3.1: close v0.7 dogfood silent-failure regressions — single-sample auto-degrade now checks column cardinality (not just presence); markers rank_genes_groups capped at 500 genes/cluster (bounds memory at 100+ clusters × 30k+ genes); integrate subsets to HVG before scale + PCA (~95% memory cut at .X, .raw retains full normalized expression). 5 new tests, 186 passed.
v1.3.0: review server + PDF export + cross-disease cold-validation; CLI gains scellrun review and scellrun export subcommands
